title: The Disappearance of Benjamin Bathurst
hook: Who erased a British diplomat in a Prussian night?
headline: Diplomat vanished without a trace

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Benjamin Bathurst disappeared on 25 November 1809 near Perleberg, Prussia.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: He was traveling by carriage with a small tight escort on the road.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Witnesses reported seeing his coach stop near a forest clearing at dusk.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: No body was found; later reports claimed a secret spy network intercepted him.

end.line: What do you think really happened to Bathurst?

description: A British diplomat vanished in 1809 near Königsberg, sparking endless speculation.
